## Navimower Map Card 0.3.4-beta10

### Resilient Navimower scheduler discovery
- Fix the managed Schedule dialog showing `Automatic order`, `Unavailable`, and an empty queue even when `Navimower schedule status` contains a valid custom queue.
- Discover the managed scheduler from the exact Navimower map/config-entry context first, then fall back through the resolved map device and mower device instead of relying only on the mower entity device.
- Remove the permanent negative scheduler cache: an early failed lookup is retried later instead of remaining empty until the card object is recreated.
- Treat the schedule status sensor's `enabled` attribute as the authoritative managed-scheduler state when available.
- Keep custom queue writes scoped to the Navimower device discovered with the scheduler status sensor.
- Add regression coverage for late entity appearance, mixed old/new mower devices, multiple scheduler status sensors, positive-cache validation, and map-device fallback.
